reporter.title: Crafting Personalized Agents through Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Editable Memory Graphs

rows.variant: NiaH (all user memories within the context window)
rows.notes: QA answers compared with GPT-4-generated reference answers (ROUGE, BLEU); autofill and services by exact match of key entities against GPT-4-extracted ones. Memories written by GPT-4 from the proprietary assistant data. Baseline implemented by the EMG-RAG authors (§5.1); its embedding model is not stated.
